assessment.title: Management Assessment on ICOFR Implementation Effectiveness
assessment.subtitle: Appendix 11 - SK-5/DKU.MBU/11/2024
assessment.effectiveDesc: Based on the evaluation performed, management concludes that the Company has maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting as of the report date.
assessment.ineffectiveDesc: Based on the evaluation performed, management concludes that the Company did not maintain effective internal control over financial reporting as of the report date, due to identified material weaknesses.
assessment.directorsStatement: The Board of Directors of {{companyName}} states that:
assessment.statement1: We have reviewed the financial statements of {{companyName}} ending on {{date}}.
assessment.statement2: To our knowledge, the financial statements do not contain any untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state a material fact necessary to make the statements made, in light of the circumstances under which such statements were made, not misleading.
assessment.statement3: To our knowledge, the financial statements and other financial information included in the financial statements, fairly present in all material respects the financial condition and results of operations for the period presented.
assessment.statement4: We have implemented controls and procedures for the preparation of financial statements deemed necessary to properly prepare and present the financial statements (consolidated) and free from material misstatement.
assessment.noDeficiencies: No significant deficiencies or material weaknesses found.
